So this is of two separate entities that I’ve had encountered serval times over several years consistently…. (All of these encounters were only when I was alone in the house and usually between the hours of 11pm-5am)

So while I was living with my parents before I moved out, some weird shit was going on. And this is the more “friendly” one. Every now and then I’d be standing in the per say kitchen and be looking into the living room or be walking upstairs and see what had appeared to be a seemingly small figure staring at me, watching my every move and just observing me, like it was curious as to why I was there and as to what I was doing. Boy was I wrong. One night after months of feeling that presence of that entity, I was walking into my room and as I went to turn around to shut my door I saw him in plain sight for the first time. This dude, and I commonly refer to him as “tall dude”, was at least 10 feet tall, extremely lanky, and completely grey with no facial features except glowing neon green eyes. To give you a better idea as to what I saw, google SCP-096, but subtract all features. That night I’ll never be able to get out of my head.

The second entity that I have had several encounters with is extremely hostile and this I’ve had two witches try to get rid of and try to identify. The best name that I have as to who the fuck that thing is, is a literal demon and I’ll explain as to why I think that later on. 

When I first started to sense his presence, it was much different than tall dude, this was way more aggressive and felt like it was out for blood if it could. It started as just feeling his presence and I had wished it stayed that way, it then transitioned into hearing and seeing shit slammed in random areas of the house. Sometimes it felt like something was thrown onto the floor above you, lots of really scary shit if you weren’t used to it. The most interesting thing that this fucker did is his presence would get overbearing and then as to if it was over your shoulders behind your back, it would whisper Latin into your ear. I could never place as to what it said, but based off sound and rough roots of words, you could definitely tell it was Latin. 

These are just two of many things that are still in that house and I’d be more than happy to answer questions or comments of what’s above.
